placements.why: Tanya's ruling that reactions must be routed through one bundled delivery per run per person—preventing per-skill notification floods and rejecting client-side collapsing—directly enforces the anti-Slack thesis of structured async decision communication over real-time chat noise.

mints.name: DeliveryRoutingArchitecture
mints.title: Delivery routing and batching architecture
mints.why: Groups technical policies, topologies, and architectural tradeoffs governing how notifications and event reactions are batched and delivered to recipients.

connections.why: Defines the core architectural routing policy of bundling reactions per run per person and closing the window at run completion.

unconnected.why: Narrative_AntiSlackPositioning is a broad market positioning anchor spanning product and messaging domains, not confined to delivery routing architecture.
